detail: Container is top-anchored with no max-height; 5 stacked toasts (72px each, 12px gaps, evidence geometry) reach y≈488. Narrow collapsed banner (~356px, fits 320×480/568, 360×640) has buttons at y≈H−175, so 3–5 live toasts cover them for 5–8s; toasts z-rank above the banner. Evidence validated one toast only.
recommended_fix: Bound the stack: max-height with overflow on the container, or clamp visible toasts to 2–3. Re-run the corner evidence with a full 5-toast stack and correct the README's every-viewport-fitting-banner guarantee.
